name: meteoswiss-forecast-evals
description: Eval suite measuring how well LLMs read meteoswissLocalForecast JSON — eval-driven interface design for tool outputs
author: Max Albrecht <1@178.is>

scripts.test: pnpm run generate && node --import tsx --test src/*.test.ts
scripts.dryrun: pnpm run generate && bash scripts/run.sh promptfooconfig.yaml --no-cache -o generated/results-dryrun.json --filter-providers echo
scripts.smoke: pnpm run generate && bash scripts/run.sh promptfooconfig.yaml -o generated/results-smoke.json --filter-providers 'gemini-2.5-flash-lite'
scripts.eval: pnpm run generate && bash scripts/run.sh promptfooconfig.yaml -o generated/results.json
scripts.eval:judge: pnpm run generate && bash scripts/run.sh promptfooconfig.judge.yaml -o generated/results-judge.json
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ts && pnpm run lint:eslint
